scripts.check: turbo run lint typecheck test --affected && bun run lint:repo
scripts.lint:repo: biome check .claude lint tools/src *.json *.ts && knip && depcruise apps packages tools --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && bun tools/src/check-no-bank.ts && bun tools/src/check-worklog.ts && bun tools/src/check-drops.ts && bun tools/src/check-research.ts && bun tools/src/check-workflows.ts && bun tools/src/check-infra-routes.ts

//.@biomejs/biome: lint and format for every package (biome.json) and the GritQL house rules in lint/*.grit; the PostToolUse hook runs it on each edited file
//.@types/bun: types for the bun-run scripts at the root: .claude/hooks/guard.ts and its bun:test file
//.@types/node: Node 24 types for the root vitest.config.ts and the hooks
//.dependency-cruiser: import direction (.dependency-cruiser.cjs): apps import packages, packages never import apps, contracts imports nothing of ours, only tests import testing
//.knip: unused files, exports and dependencies across the workspace (knip.json)
//.lefthook: the pre-commit hook (lefthook.yml): Biome on staged files and gitleaks
//.turbo: affected-only lint, typecheck and test across the workspace (turbo.json), the engine of make check
//.typescript: tsc for typecheck in every package; the strict base is tsconfig.base.json
//.vitest: the test runner every package's test script calls with the root vitest.config.ts
